epic.title: Teacher Attendance Management Module
epic.body: Enables teachers to efficiently track student attendance, manage class-wise records, and monitor historical trends for their assigned subjects and sections.

features.title: Daily Attendance Marking
features.body: Interface for teachers to record presence, absence, or leave for students in their assigned classes and subjects on a daily basis.

stories.title: Mark Student Attendance (Frontend)
stories.body: As a teacher, I want to list students for a specific class and subject and toggle their attendance status so I can submit daily records.
acceptanceCriteria: List: Admin can view all students assigned to a selected Class/Subject.
Update: Ability to toggle status between 'Present', 'Absent', and 'Leave' for each student.
Search: Filter students by name or roll number within the marking screen.
Summary: Real-time display of total present, absent, and leave counts before submission.
Submit: Finalize attendance for the selected date with a confirmation prompt.

stories.title: Attendance Record Management (Backend)
stories.body: API endpoints to save and update attendance logs mapped to specific classes, subjects, and dates.
acceptanceCriteria: Create/Update: POST/PUT endpoints to store student attendance statuses (present/absent/leave) for a specific date and class.
Validation: Ensure attendance cannot be marked for future dates.
Audit: Maintain a record of the teacher ID who submitted the attendance.

features.title: Attendance Analytics & History
features.body: Visual representation of attendance trends and detailed historical logs for individual students and classes.

stories.title: View Attendance Trends (Frontend)
stories.body: As a teacher, I want to see a monthly calendar view and percentage-based summaries of attendance to track consistency.
acceptanceCriteria: List: Display a monthly calendar with color-coded indicators for present/absent days.
Summary Card: Show 'This Month' percentage and total missed days.
Class Selector: Switch between different assigned classes to view their respective histories.

stories.title: Student Attendance Metrics (Frontend)
stories.body: As a teacher, I want to see the specific attendance percentage for each student in the student list.
acceptanceCriteria: List: Show student attendance percentage alongside their profile in the class list.
Visual Cue: Color-code percentages (e.g., green for >90%, red for <75%) to identify students with low attendance.

stories.title: Attendance Analytics Retrieval (Backend)
stories.body: API to calculate and serve attendance percentages and monthly logs for students and classes.
acceptanceCriteria: GET: Retrieve monthly attendance data for a student/class for the calendar view.
Calculation: Aggregate total days vs. present days to serve real-time attendance percentages.
